site_ui.lead: Build the compliant intake, medical-record, and operating infrastructure that helps law firms evaluate cases faster.
site_ui.summary: Measure acquisition cost per attorney-accepted, evidence-supported matter rather than per raw lead, including advertising, consent verification, record retrieval, triage, and rejection costs. Separate permissible marketing and intake services, HIPAA/HITECH-compliant record support, and nonlegal MSO administration, with jurisdiction-specific review of solicitation, referral compensation, fee splitting, ownership, and attorney independence.
chapters: Q8: Price Three Nonlegal Service Lanes
Q12: Scale Without Owning Legal Judgment
flow: Use accurate, jurisdiction-reviewed advertising without outcome promises or prohibited solicitation.
Document contact consent, privacy disclosures, and valid authority for medical-record requests.
Apply attorney-defined intake criteria while leaving legal advice and case acceptance to counsel.
Obtain records through applicable access or authorization pathways without assuming universal fee caps.
Organize source-linked medical timelines and flag gaps for qualified clinical or attorney review.
Deliver contracted nonlegal support while preserving professional independence and lawful compensation structures.
